title: Dodo Pizza: public store revenue dashboard
summary: Dodo Pizza store statistics are publicly accessible by country and location, showing previous-month revenue and opening dates. The page says it refreshes from the public Dodo IS API every 30 minutes.
research_notes:
Open the country page, choose a country or a store, then use the store table to inspect opening date and previous-month revenue.

For a comparison, set the brand, country, currency and time-window filters; review sales, year-over-year change, orders and unit age together.

Compare like-for-like locations and interpret a missing or zero year-over-year value for a newer store as the absence of a same-period baseline, not as evidence of no growth.

Record the country, currency, period and filters used before sharing a comparison, because the dashboard exposes different network slices and local currencies.
